integrity: Analytic proof and standalone deterministic finite numerical consistency tests; no external formal certification or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns strictly positive weights on Euclidean balls in orthogonal coordinate hyperplanes. It does not extend to tilted or ellipsoidal summands or classify all inscribed-ball centers; bibliographic uniqueness and independent validation are unproved.
title: Sharp radii and contact phase transitions of weighted orthogonal discotopes
